name: time-picker
title: Time Picker
author: @fma-ui/ui
description: A composable time picker: hour, minute, second and AM/PM columns in a popover (`TimePickerTrigger` + `TimePickerContent`), behind a typable field (`TimePickerInput`, which reads `930`, `14h30`, `2:30 pm`…) or in place (`TimePickerPanel`). `<TimePicker />` alone renders a trigger and a popover. Values are `@internationalized/date` `Time` objects (`value`/`defaultValue`/`onChange`, `null` when empty). `hourCycle`, `granularity` and `periodPosition` shape the columns; `hourStep`/`minuteStep`/`secondStep`, `minValue`/`maxValue` (an overnight window when min > max) and `isTimeUnavailable` narrow the choices, and a pick moves to the nearest selectable time. `requireConfirm` keeps picks as a draft until OK. Each column is an `aria-activedescendant` listbox: arrows, Home/End, PageUp/PageDown and typed digits pick, Left/Right move between columns, Enter commits and closes. `name` submits `HH:mm` (or `HH:mm:ss`) with a native form; `isRequired`, `isInvalid`, `isReadOnly` and `isDisabled` work as in react-aria. Every string comes from `i18n`. `useTimePicker()` exposes the state inside a picker.
